content.title: About
content.content: Non‑alcoholic Pina Colada is a refreshing tropical drink made from pineapple juice, coconut cream, and ice. It retains the sweet‑fruity flavor of the classic cocktail while containing no alcoholic ingredients, making it suitable for children and those who avoid alcohol.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Pina Colada was officially declared the national drink of Puerto Rico in 1978.
Although the original recipe includes rum, the non‑alcoholic version replaces it with extra pineapple juice or coconut milk.
Coconut cream used in the drink is derived from fresh coconut flesh, not just coconut milk, giving a richer texture.
Pina Colada is often served in a highball glass garnished with a pineapple wedge and a cherry.
Non‑alcoholic versions gained popularity in the United States during the 1990s as part of the health‑conscious movement.

items.title: Rich in vitamin C
items.content: Pineapple juice provides vitamin C, which supports the immune system and collagen synthesis.

items.title: Source of healthy fats
items.content: Coconut cream contains medium‑chain triglycerides that can be quickly used by the body for energy.

items.title: Aids digestion
items.content: Bromelain, an enzyme present in pineapple, helps break down proteins and eases digestion.

items.title: Hydration
items.content: The drink is mostly water and fruit juice, helping maintain proper fluid balance.

items.title: Low sugar when homemade
items.content: By controlling added sugar, you can keep the calorie count modest.

items.title: Coconut allergy
items.content: Some individuals may be allergic to coconut cream, which can cause skin reactions or digestive issues.

items.title: High sugar content
items.content: Commercial ready‑to‑drink versions often contain added sugars, which can raise blood glucose levels.

items.title: Acidity of pineapple
items.content: The acids in pineapple juice may irritate a sensitive stomach if consumed in excess.

items.title: Caloric density
items.content: Coconut cream is calorie‑rich; portion control is advisable for those watching weight.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Serve non‑alcoholic Pina Colada chilled, typically in a tall glass, garnished with a pineapple slice, cherry, or mint. A splash of fresh lime can brighten the flavor. It pairs well with light snacks, fruit salads, and seafood dishes.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the prepared drink in the refrigerator for up to 24 hours to preserve freshness and coconut aroma. If using pre‑made coconut cream, keep it according to package instructions, usually refrigerated after opening.
